nodes.rationale: Intelligence does not become sovereignty until it can acquire durable, consequential agency.
nodes.statement: Algorithmic capability (A), strategic hardware (H), and power-conversion affordances (P) are related but distinct variables and should not be governed as though they always change together.
nodes.title: Separate capability, substrate, and power

nodes.rationale: This preserves learning and option value while retaining intervention points.
nodes.statement: The objective is to slow and condition the conversion of frontier intelligence into irreversible economic, political, military, and physical power, not to freeze intelligence as such.
nodes.title: Pace conversion into irreversible power

nodes.rationale: Discovering a capability should not automatically confer the right to deploy it.
nodes.statement: Research inside genuinely bounded environments may proceed under a different regime from public, commercial, military, governmental, or otherwise power-conferring use.
nodes.title: Govern bounded research and consequential use differently

nodes.rationale: Safety evidence becomes a condition of access to economic and strategic rents.
nodes.statement: Consequential use that materially exceeds the observable foreign public capability frontier requires an adversarial control and safety case.
nodes.title: Require adversarial assurance above the public frontier

nodes.rationale: A grand bargain is not a credible prerequisite for initial action.
nodes.statement: The regime should begin as a domestically justified institution that can operate without foreign agreement and later admit deeper reciprocal cooperation.
nodes.title: Start domestically and remain internationally extensible

nodes.rationale: Cooperation can occur through a precommitted policy rule rather than trust.
nodes.statement: Observable foreign public capability should alter the domestic safe-harbor frontier so that foreign restraint can be reciprocated without a treaty and foreign release cannot exploit unilateral domestic restraint indefinitely.
nodes.title: Make foreign public capability an automatic reciprocity input

nodes.rationale: Observable intermediate boundaries create chances to learn before failures become irreversible.
nodes.statement: Governance should maximize the interval between credible detection of a dangerous transition and the point at which humans can no longer respond effectively.
nodes.title: Maximize warning time

nodes.statement: A domestic compact governs transitions from bounded research into public, commercial, military, governmental, or other consequential use.
nodes.title: Capability Release Compact

nodes.statement: Qualified competitors receive controlled access sufficient to attack a frontier applicant's case; the government adjudicates and competitors do not hold a veto.
nodes.title: Rival laboratories provide the technical attack surface

nodes.statement: Because above-frontier monetization depends on passing hostile review, controllability becomes a production input rather than only a cost.
nodes.title: Safety becomes part of the profit function

nodes.statement: Reversibility depends on both the quantity of strategic hardware and the degree to which civilian society depends on its continued operation.
nodes.title: Compute stock and compute entanglement differ

nodes.statement: Predefined boundaries around external agency create high-value warning signals when systems cross them without legitimate authorization.
nodes.title: Unauthorized agency can be made epistemically valuable

nodes.statement: Cooperation progresses from tacit public-frontier reciprocity to narrow abstention, incident exchange, reciprocal review, hardware declarations, activation rules, and only later treaty-level restraints.
nodes.title: International cooperation can deepen in stages

nodes.evidence_needed: Repeated control evaluations across architectures and access configurations.
nodes.falsifier: Frontier algorithms reliably manufacture their own access to credentials, money, compute, persistence, or physical resources before humans can intervene.
nodes.statement: There is a policy-relevant interval in which algorithmic progress does not automatically create uncontainable access to hardware and external power.
nodes.stopping_rule: If bounded systems repeatedly acquire durable external agency faster than detection and response, stop treating research/deployment separation as a sufficient primary control.
nodes.title: A/H/P separability remains actionable

nodes.evidence_needed: Secure pilot reviews, objection quality, leakage audits, and incentive measurements.
nodes.falsifier: Review access produces material leakage or convergent leniency without compensating safety discoveries.
nodes.statement: Controlled competitor access reduces undetected risk and concentration more than it increases leakage, proliferation, collusion, and aggregate acceleration.
nodes.stopping_rule: Suspend rival access when marginal information-security loss exceeds demonstrated review value.
nodes.title: Rival review has positive safety value after proliferation costs

nodes.evidence_needed: Domain-specific demonstrations, cost/access measurements, and repeatable equivalence protocols.
nodes.falsifier: Hidden scaffolds, access conditions, or multidimensional capability make equivalent release determinations systematically manipulable.
nodes.statement: Practical foreign capability can be observed across domains with sufficient reliability to serve as one input to domestic safe-harbor decisions.
nodes.stopping_rule: Replace automatic equivalence with narrower domain rules wherever measurement error dominates reciprocity value.
nodes.title: The foreign public frontier is measurable enough to govern

nodes.evidence_needed: Timed mobilization exercises, inspection trials, supply-chain modeling, and red-team concealment attempts.
nodes.falsifier: Reserve compute can be commissioned or substituted covertly before observers can detect and interrupt it.
nodes.statement: Declared reserve hardware can be stored so covert activation takes longer than independent detection and effective response.
nodes.stopping_rule: Do not count hardware as reversible reserve when measured covert activation time is at or below response time.
nodes.title: Physical activation latency can preserve reversibility

nodes.evidence_needed: Coalition analysis, polling, legislative pilots, investment behavior, and distributional modeling.
nodes.falsifier: The regime remains politically dependent on catastrophic-risk beliefs and is repealed when those beliefs weaken.
nodes.statement: Predictable release rules, competition, taxation, safer deployment, and protection against foreign release can create a durable domestic constituency.
nodes.stopping_rule: Redesign entry mechanisms when the supporting coalition cannot survive an electoral turnover.
nodes.title: Domestic benefits can sustain the institution

nodes.statement: Define prohibited external agency by observable actions rather than model architecture or legal labels.
nodes.title: Architecture-neutral unauthorized-agency boundary

nodes.statement: Require affirmative surveillance, automatic evidence preservation, prompt reporting on reasonable suspicion, a reporting safe harbor, and severe penalties for concealment.
nodes.title: Surveil, preserve, and report

nodes.statement: The applicant stakes controlled technical access to its candidate system as the price of seeking above-frontier release.
nodes.title: Weights-as-bond review process

nodes.statement: Store reserve accelerators uninstalled, unracked, unnetworked, and detached from dedicated power and cooling, subject to independent observation.
nodes.title: Observable uncommissioned hardware reserve

nodes.statement: Scrutinize automation that removes independently controlled human dependencies over compute, power, fabrication, repair, logistics, and reproduction.
nodes.title: Separate gate for the AI industrial survival chain

nodes.statement: Implement public reciprocity, capability abstention, incident exchange, reciprocal review, hardware declarations, activation controls, and treaty restraint in that order.
nodes.title: Seven-stage international ladder

nodes.statement: Use deployment licensing as an administrative and potentially populist tax base for large data centers.
nodes.title: Licensed compute deployment and data-center taxation

nodes.statement: Define domain, reliability, autonomy, cost, scaffolding, accessibility, and deployment conditions for frontier equivalence.
nodes.title: How should practical public capability be measured?

nodes.statement: Determine the minimum reproducible access, security, and adjudication protocol.
nodes.title: What access makes adversarial review credible without unacceptable leakage?

nodes.statement: Determine when energy, compute, fabrication, repair, logistics, and governance dependencies are genuinely independent.
nodes.title: How many independent human vetoes are enough?

nodes.statement: Identify architectures or behaviors that make power boundaries infeasible before formal review.
nodes.title: When does capability itself collapse A/H/P separability?

authority.rule: A rendering or verification MUST resolve the version it targets to an immutable full Git commit object ID. Branch names and website pages are discovery aids, not verification targets.

allowed: Change medium, tone, ordering, examples, and level of detail.
Limit scope when the omitted claims are declared.
Criticize or vary identified propositions when the relationship is declared.
generator_contract.authoritative_object: this specification at an immutable Git commit
forbidden: Turn an implementation option into a kernel proposition.
Turn a hypothesis or open question into an established conclusion.
Change a proposition without checking its dependent claims.
Attribute a synthesis claim to a source that merely motivated it.
Claim verification without naming the verifier, commit, policy, and evidence.
